title: Check if Every Row and Column Contains All Numbers
summary: Determine if an n x n matrix is valid by checking if each row and column contains all integers from 1 to n exactly once.
statement: Determine if an n x n matrix is valid by checking if each row and column contains all integers from 1 to n exactly once.
constraints: matrix is n by n with values intended from one through n.
Every row and every column must contain each number from one through n exactly once.
Return whether the matrix is valid.
hints: Every valid row and column has exactly the required set {1,...,n}.
Build the required set and compare it against each row set and each column set.
With n positions and permitted values, set equality enforces both presence and uniqueness in every line.
editorial: With n positions and permitted values, set equality enforces both presence and uniqueness in every line.

tests.explanation: Every row and column contains one, two, and three exactly once.
The first row repeats one and the columns are also incomplete.
